simpleearth.screen.title: Simple Earth
simpleearth.screen.reset.tip: Sets every value of this version and the display settings back to their defaults
simpleearth.screen.dev_button.tip: Simple Earth: version and settings (dev button)
simpleearth.version.1.name: V1 Tile cube
simpleearth.version.1.desc: Fixed tiles, the cube turns by the shortest rotation; over a corner it flips about the diagonal.
simpleearth.version.2.name: V2 Cone fold
simpleearth.version.2.desc: Like V1, but around each corner the fourth tile is squeezed in as a wedge.
simpleearth.version.3.name: V3 Corner window
simpleearth.version.3.desc: Like V1; near a corner a small window shows the diagonal tile, crossing it turns the cube inside out like a tesseract.
simpleearth.version.4.name: V4 Rolling cube
simpleearth.version.4.desc: The cube rolls on under you without jerks; side faces blend the old and new neighbor.
simpleearth.version.5.name: V5 Smooth ball
simpleearth.version.5.desc: A rounder body whose ground under you always stays level.
simpleearth.version.6.name: V6 Folding net
simpleearth.version.6.desc: Standard. Nothing turns: the tile under you stays flat and the neighbors fold in from the edge.
simpleearth.version.7.name: V7 Cell net
simpleearth.version.7.desc: The folding net made of flat cube cells - the unfolding net of a four-dimensional cube.
simpleearth.version.8.name: V8 Net and inversion
simpleearth.version.8.desc: The folding net; corner windows fill the gaps and the corner of the world turns inside out.
simpleearth.version.9.name: V9 Folding shell
simpleearth.version.9.desc: All 25 tiles stay joined: the corner tiles open like windows, nothing ever fades.
simpleearth.version.10.name: V10 Tipping cube
simpleearth.version.10.desc: A sharp cube, its top always level under you. At an edge it tips over like a rolled die; bright edge lines.
simpleearth.version.11.name: V11 Puzzle cube
simpleearth.version.11.desc: Tips like V10; every face is split into pieces with joints over a dark core - a cube built from cubes.
simpleearth.version.12.name: V12 Corner view
simpleearth.version.12.desc: Tips like V10; the higher you fly, the more a corner turns up to you until three faces show like a block icon.
simpleearth.version.13.name: V13 Orbit ball
simpleearth.version.13.desc: Rounder than V5 (nearly a sphere, like the COBE cube): you orbit it - flying turns the earth under you at a constant distance.
simpleearth.version.14.name: V14 Orbit cube-ball
simpleearth.version.15.name: V15 Orbit V5 + window
simpleearth.version.15.desc: The V5 shape in orbit; towards a corner the diagonal tile opens as a framed window on the body.
simpleearth.version.16.name: V16 Orbit fourth face
simpleearth.version.16.desc: Rounded cube in orbit; at a corner a fourth face spreads over the three faces, so four meet.
simpleearth.version.17.name: V17 Orbit cube
simpleearth.version.17.desc: A sharp cube with edge lines that you orbit: always the face under you below, smooth all the way.
simpleearth.version.18.name: V18 Orbit corner view
simpleearth.version.18.desc: V12 done right: orbiting, and higher up a corner turns smoothly towards you.
simpleearth.version.19.name: V19 Orbit cube + window
simpleearth.version.19.desc: Orbit cube with slightly rounded edges and a framed corner window.
simpleearth.version.20.name: V20 Orbit cube, four faces
simpleearth.version.20.desc: Rounder orbit cube; at a corner the fourth face covers it - four faces meet.
simpleearth.version.21.name: V21 Rolling shell
simpleearth.version.21.desc: V9's joined shell, folding by position and rolling with the orbit.
simpleearth.version.22.name: V22 Rolling bowl
simpleearth.version.22.desc: A shell folded half way (45 degrees), rolling as a whole.
simpleearth.version.23.name: V23 Closing shell
simpleearth.version.23.desc: Flat near the render switch, closing into a cube as you climb; rolling.
simpleearth.version.24.name: V24 Folded net cube
simpleearth.version.24.desc: The net folded fully into a cube with its hinges drawn, rolling.
simpleearth.version.25.name: V25 Folding world
simpleearth.version.25.desc: Climb past the render height: the flat map blends in, then folds into the earth cube - over a face, an edge or a corner, depending on where you are.
simpleearth.version.26.name: V26 Folding world, rounded
simpleearth.version.26.desc: Like V25; the folded cube then rounds towards V5's body.
simpleearth.version.27.name: V27 Folding world, ball
simpleearth.version.27.desc: Like V25; the folded cube then becomes nearly a ball.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.title: Simple Earth
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.switc: From this height on the earth is shown (there is no activation height any more). Default: 1536.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.ceili: At this height the earth is furthest away (orbit distance). Default: 6144.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.fadeB: Blocks above the render height in which the flat map blends in (phase A, eased). Default: 128.
Blocks per earth face; world 0 ~ 0 is the middle of the top face, half an edge from it lies a face edge. Default: 2048.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.orbit: How far away the earth is at the ceiling height, in cube widths. Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.relie: Map shading by height like a Vanilla map (1 = Vanilla). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.atmos: Strength of the stepped atmosphere rim. Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.moonS: Size of the cube moon (0 = no moon). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.stars: Brightness of the stars in orbit. Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.round: How round the edges and corners are (3-step stair like the UI frames). Default: 0.07 (V10: 0.02).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: Seconds of the turn over the corner of the world. Default: 0.35.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldR: How far around each corner the plane is folded (share of half a face). Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.inver: Seconds of the tesseract inversion at a corner. Default: 0.9.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.windo: From which distance to the corner the corner window opens (0 = middle, 1 = corner). Default: 0.5.
Largest size of the corner window. Default: 0.62.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.follo: How quickly the shown cube follows its true position (higher = stiffer). Default: 6 (V5: 10).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.north: How quickly north turns back to the top of the screen. Default: 2.5.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.expon: Shape of the smooth body: low = ball, high = cube. Default: 8.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldS: From which point of the face the neighbor starts to fold in (0 = middle). Default: 0.1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.cellD: Depth of the cube cells. Default: 0.18.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.lineA: Visibility of the hinge and tesseract lines. Default: 0.6 (V9: 0.35).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.enabl: Server: turns Simple Earth on or off. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.dimen: Server: dimensions with an orbit. Default: the Overworld.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.minAc: Server: lowest render height a client may choose (never below build height + 64). Default: 384.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.explo: Server: shows terrain only where the world already has region files, so the earth gives away no seed map. Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.showO: E9: other players in orbit appear as dots (players on the ground never). A server option and a display option; both must be on. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.realD: WG26-2: the earth lies as far below as the world would (height above sea level, true size); off = the earlier zoom (real height at the switch, growing to the orbit distance at the ceiling). Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.worke: Server: background threads that read terrain from the world generator. Default: half the CPU cores, 2 to 4.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tiles: Server: terrain tiles each player gets per second. Default: 24.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.memor: Server: terrain tiles kept in memory. Default: 1024.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.diskC: Server: size of the tile cache in the world folder, oldest deleted first (0 = none). Default: 256.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.detai: The edge in n pixels: 1 = one color per face, 2 = 2 x 2, 16 = 16 x 16, 256 = 256 x 256 per face. Default: 256.
How many tile rings around yours keep the full detail level; every ring further is half as fine. Default: 0.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.rende: How far the earth is drawn, in tile rings around yours: 1 = only the neighbors, 2 = everything (far ring and the cube bottom). Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.paint: Thousand pixels of face images painted per frame. Lower keeps the frame rate steady, higher sharpens faster. Default: 192.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.textu: How many painted face images stay in memory. Default: 64.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tileC: How many terrain tiles from the server the client keeps (about 12 KB each). Default: 2048.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.faceE: How dark the 1-pixel border of every tile is (0 = none). Default: 0.28.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.moonP: E10: the cube moon follows Vanilla's moon phase; off = always full moon. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tipTi: Seconds the cube takes to tip over an edge. Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.edgeL: How bright the twelve cube edges are drawn (0 = none). Default: 0.8.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.cells: Each face is split into this many x this many pieces. Default: 3.
Gap between the pieces (share of the face). Default: 0.05.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: How far the corner turns up to you at the top (1 = three faces equally, 0 = never). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tiltS: Share of the way from the render switch to the ceiling height where the corner starts to turn. Default: 0.35.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.minGr: Server: finest sample spacing served, 2^value blocks (5 = 32). Caps what high client detail levels cost. Default: 5.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.biome: Server: from 128 blocks per pixel the biome is asked at value x value points and the majority wins (1 = one point; 3 = smoother, slower). Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.surfa: Server: what the generator puts on top - snow where Vanilla's height temperature lets it snow, frozen water, stone on steep slopes, badlands red sand and bands. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.requi: Server, E5: off = any way up counts; on = the orbit only starts while flying (creative flight or elytra). Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.fastH: Server: ground height from the generator's preliminary surface level, like Chunkbase (many times faster); off = the exact noise column per sample (slow). Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.follo: How fast the earth turns after you (30 = almost at once). Default: 30.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: From which point towards a corner the fourth face appears (share of the way). Default: 0.4.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldA: Degrees the neighboring tiles are folded (V22 fixed, V23 the start near the switch). Default: 45 (V23: 15).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.rotat: How much the shell turns with the orbit (1 = fully, 0 = like V9). Default: 1 (V21: 0.6).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldB: Blocks above the blend band in which the flat map folds into the cube. Default: 1024.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: The same over a corner (it folds three ways). Default: 2048.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.easin: Ease in and out: 1 = linear, 2 = soft, higher = slow start and end, quick middle. Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: The curve over a corner. Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.round: How far the folded cube rounds towards V5's body (1 = fully). Default: 0.6 (V27: 1).
simpleearth.guide.page.1.title: Simple Earth
simpleearth.guide.page.1: Fly very high and the Overworld turns into a cube in orbit, its faces painted in map colors straight from the world generator. Below everything stays Vanilla. Open this guide again with /simpleearth guide.
simpleearth.guide.page.2.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.2: World 0 ~ 0 is the middle of the earth's top face (there is no activation height). From the render height (default 1536) on, where you are relative to 0 ~ 0 is where you are over the earth, like a map:
simpleearth.guide.page.3.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.3: with the default edge of 2048 blocks the face edge lies 1024 blocks from 0 ~ 0. You fly freely (creative flight or elytra); nothing holds or teleports you.
simpleearth.guide.page.4.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.4: In the folding world (V25-V27, standard) the flat map blends in over the blend-in band and then folds into the cube - you end above a face middle, an edge middle or a corner, depending on where you are.
simpleearth.guide.page.5.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.5: In orbit there is no rain, snow, ambient particles or clouds on your client. Only the Overworld by default; players without the mod never take part. Server option: requireFlight (E5).
simpleearth.guide.page.6.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.6: The faces show Vanilla map colors (grass, leaves, sand, snow, water, terracotta ...) with map-style height shading. Each pixel is one sample read from the world generator: the ground height (standard:
simpleearth.guide.page.7.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.7: the generator's preliminary surface, one density function per column - fastHeights) and the noise biome there, like Chunkbase - no chunk is loaded or generated.
simpleearth.guide.page.8.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.8: Samples sit on a global grid (64 x 64 per tile), are sampled by background threads (default half the CPU cores, 2 to 4), cached in memory and in the world folder (default 256 MiB, oldest deleted first) and sent at up
simpleearth.guide.page.9.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.9: to 24 tiles per second per player. Faces start coarse and sharpen. Surface detail (server option surfaceDetail, on):
simpleearth.guide.page.10.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.10: snow where Vanilla's height-adjusted biome temperature lets it snow, frozen water in cold biomes, stone or packed ice on steep slopes, red sand and terracotta bands in the badlands - all from heights and biomes, still without
simpleearth.guide.page.11.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.11: chunks. Biome color table: data/<namespace>/simpleearth/biome_colors.json in any data pack (exact biome ids and tag rules, map color names; Simple End's biomes and the c:
simpleearth.guide.page.12.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.12: convention tags ship with the mod), otherwise the map color nearest the biome's grass color. minGrid caps the finest grid the server serves (32 blocks), biomeVotes sets the biome majority per pixel.
simpleearth.guide.page.13.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.13: With exploredOnly only areas with region files are shown.
simpleearth.guide.page.14.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.14: Behind every edge lies new terrain: four faces north is 4 edge lengths away, never back at the start (tesseract).
simpleearth.guide.page.15.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.15: V1 tile cube (shortest turn, flip at the corner), V2 cone fold (fourth tile squeezed in as a wedge),
simpleearth.guide.page.16.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.16: V3 corner window and tesseract inversion, V4 rolling cube (no jerk, side faces blend), V5 smooth ball (ground always level), V6 folding net
simpleearth.guide.page.17.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.17: (standard: the tile under you stays flat, neighbors fold in), V7 cell net (net of flat cube cells), V8 net with corner windows and inversion, V9 folding shell (all 25 tiles joined, nothing fades). V10-V12 stress the cube:
simpleearth.guide.page.18.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.18: V10 tipping cube (sharp, top always level, tips over an edge like a rolled die, edge lines), V11 puzzle cube (tips like V10,
simpleearth.guide.page.19.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.19: faces split into pieces with joints over a dark core), V12 corner view (tips like V10, higher up a corner turns towards
simpleearth.guide.page.20.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.20: you until three faces show like a block icon). Edges and corners are rounded in three steps like the UI frames. V13-V24 (26.10.) are orbited:
simpleearth.guide.page.21.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.21: the eye keeps its distance from the earth's centre, flying turns the earth under you and the ground below is always the surface under the player (equiangular cube faces).
simpleearth.guide.page.22.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.22: V13-V16 rounded like V5 (V13 nearly a sphere, V15 corner window, V16 a fourth face covering the corner), V17-V20 sharp cubes like V12 (V18 corner up with height, V19 window, V20 fourth face), V21-V24 V9's joined shell rolling with the
simpleearth.guide.page.23.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.23: orbit (by position, as a 45-degree bowl, closing with height, fully folded). V25-V27 (standard V25) are the folding world:
simpleearth.guide.page.24.title: 27 versions
simpleearth.guide.page.24: blend, fold by height with eased curves (own band and curve over a corner), V26 rounds towards V5, V27 nearly to a ball.
simpleearth.guide.page.25.title: Sky
simpleearth.guide.page.25: In orbit the sky is black with stars, the sun stays a flat square far away, the moon is a small rounded cube lit by the sun whose position follows Vanilla's moon phase, and a stepped atmosphere rim glows blue on the day side,
simpleearth.guide.page.26.title: Sky
simpleearth.guide.page.26: indigo at night and orange at the light border. The earth fades in over the blend-in band above the switch height.
simpleearth.guide.page.27.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.27: Key O (or the Earth button top left in the pause menu in a development environment, devButton in simpleearth-client.json) opens a box at the right edge:
simpleearth.guide.page.28.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.28: the world stays visible, the movement keys keep working, the mouse works the menu. Pick V1 to V12 (two rows);
simpleearth.guide.page.29.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.29: the list first shows the display settings of all versions - detail level (1-5, standard 3 = twice as fine as before near you),
simpleearth.guide.page.30.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.30: detail range, render distance (tile rings), paint budget per frame, cached images and tiles, tile border, moon phases
simpleearth.guide.page.31.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.31: (E10), other players (E9) - then that version's own values (heights, edge length, sampling grid, orbit distance, shading, atmosphere, moon, stars and its own style values) as sliders - drag, click minus or plus, or Shift and the wheel.
simpleearth.guide.page.32.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.32: Changes apply at once and are saved (display once, the rest per version; also /simpleclient simpleearth); the server clamps heights and edge. The new versions V25-V27 are direct buttons, all others (V1-V24) sit in the drop-down below;
simpleearth.guide.page.33.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.33: the list starts with edge length, render height, blend-in band and detail level (n = the edge in n pixels). Heights, size and look are one set for all versions. Hold left Alt for free look (the mouse turns only the camera).
